integrity_statement: The homotopy and symmetry claims are proved by exhaustive structural parity classification of all perfect matchings and a natural simplicial nerve comparison; finite computations are corroborative and not substituted for proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to two-terminal graphs with r>=4 internally disjoint paths each at least two edges; no claim for arbitrary series-parallel graphs or ordinary matching complexes. External independent validation has not been performed. A distinct equivalent description in inaccessible or unindexed literature cannot be excluded.
title: A parity phase diagram and orientation character for perfect-matching complexes of multi-theta graphs
